title: Characterization of One-Sided Randomized Time
statement: For every function $p:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Q}$ and every language $L$ of bit strings, $L$ belongs to the class of languages decided in polynomial time with acceptance probability at least $p(|x|)$ on members and certain rejection on nonmembers exactly when there is a polynomial-time verifier using polynomially many random bits that has those same acceptance and rejection guarantees.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ maps natural numbers to rational numbers
$L$ is a language of bit strings
